name: Interior
_design: Canon asks for an equipment store, and this is one: rope, lamp oil, cleats and the blue mineral, with the restoratives shelved behind them. The prices are what it costs to get a barrel over the Wintergate, and the town subsidises exactly one line on the list.

text: A coil of line as thick as your wrist, and a card hanging off the end of it:
GUIDE ROPE. SOLD BY THE HOUSE LENGTH. THE TOWN PAYS HALF AND ALWAYS HAS.
The half the town pays is the reason there is a rope on every street out there.
Jars of a blue mineral, ground fine, in every size from a thimble to a bucket.
FROSTMERE BLUE. BURNS COLD, BURNS SLOW, AND CANNOT BE MISTAKEN FOR A WINDOW.
It is dug out of one seam above the town and it is not sold anywhere else.
Cleats, crampons, a short axe, and a board of them all with the prices chalked.
Somebody has added at the bottom: NONE OF THIS MAKES THE LAKE SAFE THIS YEAR.
The shopkeeper has not rubbed it out, which tells you what they think of it.
